title: Source Quality
goals: Explain the mechanism and terminology of conflicting and time-sensitive sources
Apply the stated procedure to a new case with a traceable result
Identify an assumption or limitation and design a revealing follow-up
vocabulary: When a declared change begins to apply
A documented replacement relationship between versions
The time conditions a claim concerns

blocks.text: Notice N says room A from Monday. Signed amendment M references N and changes to B effective Wednesday. Query asks Tuesday, then Thursday.
Tuesday uses A; Thursday uses B. The amendment effective time, not merely upload order, determines the change.

Compare the intermediate evidence with the final statement. Explain why each number or decision follows from the stated inputs. guided_practice.title: Trace the worked case
guided_practice.prompt: Notice N says room A from Monday. Signed amendment M references N and changes to B effective Wednesday. Query asks Tuesday, then Thursday. Show the intermediate steps and give the conclusion with its scope.
guided_practice.answer: Teacher explanation: Tuesday uses A; Thursday uses B. The amendment effective time, not merely upload order, determines the change.

independent_case.title: Apply a new case independently
independent_case.task: Original allows capacity 14. Signed amendment lowers it to 9 effective day 5. Query concerns days 4 and 6. Trace both and preserve versions.
independent_case.answer: Teacher explanation: Day 4 limit 14; day 6 limit 9. Cite the applicable version and retain the supersession link.
independent_case.source: primary source W4, first curriculum occurrence

misconceptions: The worked result establishes every future case
An unspecified authority or effective-time rule leaves a conflict unresolved; do not invent precedence.
A missing input may be replaced without recording the change
A replacement changes the evidence or contract. Record the change and its justification; do not silently turn unknown into a measured value.
Repeating an assessed case is new independent evidence
A replay checks consistency. An example used for feedback or revision cannot later be described as untouched final evaluation.
